np.noPython.title: Python 3 is required
np.noPython.body: Install python3 so the widget can talk to Sonolith.

np.starting.title: Connecting…
np.unavailable.title: Sonolith isn't running, or Connected apps are off.
np.unavailable.body: Start Sonolith and turn on Settings → Connected apps → Let other apps connect to Sonolith.
np.unregistered.title: Connect to Sonolith
np.unregistered.body: See what's playing in your bar, control playback and browse your library. Sonolith will ask you to approve it.
np.pending.title: Approve the request in Sonolith…
np.pending.body: Sonolith is showing what this widget wants to do. The request expires in 5 minutes.
np.pending.identity: The widget's helper moved, so Sonolith asks you to approve it again.
np.denied.title: Request denied
np.expired.title: Nobody answered in time
np.blocked.title: Blocked in Sonolith
np.blocked.body: Unblock it in Sonolith's Settings → Connected apps.
np.disconnected.title: Disconnected from Sonolith
np.disconnected.body: Connect again to see what's playing.
toast.timeout.title: Sonolith didn't answer in time
toast.timeout.body: YouTube or Sonolith is slow right now. Try again in a moment.
toast.signedOut.title: Sign in in Sonolith
toast.signedOut.body: This needs your YouTube account. Sign in in Sonolith first.
